title: 第一卷 第15章 神奇的铭文第一卷 第16章 太虚秘录
content_zh:
不待见？
何止是不待见，自己尚在炎城之时，便已经遇到不小的麻烦。
“而且，你要知道，你入焚月书院，将直接是内门弟子。”
“可在轮回书院，你要从杂役弟子一步步做起，想要晋升，极其困难。”
楚天心看了四周一眼：“这段时间是新弟子入院之时，想必你刚来还未曾登记在册，若是随我去焚月书院，倒也来得及。”
叶寒看向老师莫轻柔，便发现老师的眼眸温和，平静望着自己，没有任何建议，似乎一切听凭自己选择。
看着手中的令牌，顿时浮现过那些人的面孔，沉寂了足足半晌，叶寒突然间定了决心。
“武道一途，始终是逆流而上，与天争路！”
“若陆云霄之辈能阻我步伐，我就这样回头，便是退缩，我心无畏！”
叶寒看着面带希冀的楚天心：“今日一切，前辈好意，叶寒在心里记下了，只是我既已拿到了这块令牌，便不愿就此退出！”
“你应该明白，机会转瞬即逝！”
楚天心依旧凝视着叶寒。
“我要踏入这轮回书院，谁也阻止不了！”
叶寒一字一顿地说道。
“嗯！”
楚天心面表无情，说完之后就直接带着楚幼诗远去。
“小子，若有意愿，焚月书院随时欢迎你。”
一道声音就这样传入叶寒耳中，却是以无上手段暗中传来，只有叶寒能听到。
目睹楚天心两人离开，而后此间众人的目光全部凝聚叶寒身上。
尤其身侧这名老人，更是双目炯炯，如同要看破虚妄，洞穿叶寒的一切秘密。

只可惜，观察良久，老人都一无所获，在他眼中叶寒只是个体内元力较之常人更为雄厚，根基还算不错的少年。
但他知道，楚天心那等人物不会无的放矢，无故去招揽一个平平无奇的少年。
“莫丫头，你一晃眼消失九年，没想到隐居在了炎城，还收了这样一位弟子。”
老人开口了，略有赞赏地看着叶寒：“逆流而上，与天争路，我喜欢你的态度，我虽不能插手莫丫头之事，不过有一点你倒是放心，你已拥有身份令牌，自然可堂堂正正踏入轮回书院。”
“弟子莫轻柔，见过季长老！”
莫轻柔言语之间，对这老人倒多有亲近之意。
“好，回来就好！”
老人看向莫轻柔的脸上也多了几分亲切：“你老师知道，也应无比高兴。”
这时，叶寒只感觉到一股劲风袭来，下一瞬面前已经出现了一名四十上下的中年美妇，虽已过风华年龄，却面容精致，风韵犹存，想必年轻时也是位国色天香的女子。
“老师！”
莫轻柔凝视着女子，目光复杂，眼角渐渐湿润。
“老东西，丫头回来，不第一时间告诉我？”
妇人瞪视一眼季长老，随后眼中泛起泪光，将莫轻柔的双手紧贴心口：“丫头，你真是狠心，就这样离开九年，一走了无音讯。”
“这些年，你过得怎么样？在炎城受了什么委屈没有……。”
妇人碎碎念般不断开口，却无不体现着关切之心。
看着这一幕，叶寒不禁放心不少，看来老师在这轮回书院，还有长辈照顾。
妇人旁若无人地说着，就推着莫轻柔远去，雷厉风行。
“叶寒，以后你来竹韵峰找我。”
content_en:
Don’t want to see you?
Not only did he not want to see him, he had already encountered a lot of trouble when he was still in Yancheng.
"Furthermore, you have to know that when you enter Burning Moon Academy, you will directly become an inner disciple."
"But in Reincarnation Academy, you have to start as a handyman disciple step by step. It is extremely difficult to get promoted."
Chu Tianxin glanced around: "This period is when new disciples are admitted to the hospital. You must have not been registered when you first arrived. If you follow me to Fenyue Academy, you will be able to do it in time."
Ye Han looked at his teacher Mo Qingrou, and found that the teacher's eyes were gentle, looking at him calmly, without any suggestions, as if everything was left to his own choice.
Looking at the token in his hand, the faces of those people suddenly appeared. After being silent for a long while, Ye Han suddenly made up his mind.
"The journey of martial arts is always to swim against the current and fight against the sky!"
"If people like Lu Yunxiao can stop me, then if I turn back like this, I will retreat. I have no fear!"
Ye Han looked at Chu Tianxin who looked hopeful: "Everything today is due to the kindness of my seniors. Ye Han has written it down in his heart, but now that I have obtained this token, I don't want to quit just yet!"
"You should understand that opportunities are fleeting!"
Chu Tianxin still stared at Ye Han.
"I want to step into this Samsara Academy, and no one can stop me!"
Ye Han said word by word.
"Yeah!"
Chu Tian looked ruthless, and after saying that, he took Chu Youshi away directly.
"Boy, if you are willing, Burning Moon Academy welcomes you at any time."
A sound passed into Ye Han's ears like this, but it was transmitted secretly through the supreme means, and only Ye Han could hear it.
Seeing Chu Tianxin and the two leaving, everyone's eyes were focused on Ye Han.
Especially the old man beside him, his eyes were piercing, as if he wanted to see through illusions and penetrate all Ye Han's secrets.
It's a pity that after long observation, the old man found nothing. In his eyes, Ye Han was just a young man with stronger internal energy than ordinary people and a fairly good foundation.
But he knew that people like Chu Tianxin would not recruit an ordinary young man without any reason.
"Girl Mo, you disappeared in the blink of an eye for nine years. I didn't expect that you would live in seclusion in Yancheng and take on such a disciple."
The old man spoke and looked at Ye Han with slight admiration: "Go against the current and fight against the sky. I like your attitude. Although I can't interfere in Mo Yatou's affairs, you can rest assured of one thing. You already have the identity token, so you can enter the Reincarnation Academy with dignity."
"Disciple Mo Qingrou has met Elder Ji!"
Mo Qingrou seemed to feel close to the old man in his words.
"Okay, just come back!"
The old man looked at Mo Qingrou and his face became a little more cordial: "Your teacher should be extremely happy if he knows."
At this time, Ye Han only felt a strong wind coming, and in the next moment, a beautiful middle-aged woman in her forties appeared in front of her. Although she was past her prime, her face was delicate and her charm was still there. She must have been a beautiful woman when she was young.
"Teacher!"
Mo Qingrou stared at the woman with complicated eyes, and the corners of her eyes gradually became moist.
"Old man, why didn't you tell me as soon as the girl came back?"
The woman glared at Elder Ji, then tears filled her eyes, and she put Mo Qingrou's hands close to her heart: "Girl, you are so cruel, leaving like this for nine years without any news."
"How have you been in these years? Have you suffered any grievances in Yancheng..."
The woman kept talking like she was thinking, but all of them showed her concern.
Looking at this scene, Ye Han couldn't help but feel relieved. It seemed that the teacher was in Samsara Academy and was being taken care of by his elders.
The woman said as if there was no one around, and pushed Mo Qingrou away, resolutely.
"Ye Han, come to Zhuyun Peak to find me from now on."
